bullet: Redirect to the agent-server's own route (`F19.oauth-redirect-route`).
script:
CBR="$RUN_URL/api/mcp/oauth/redirect" JP=$(control-agent-server api POST /api/mcp/oauth/start --expect 200 --save F19.oauth-redirect-route/start \ --json "$(jq -nc --argjson s "$OAUTH_SRV" --arg cb "$RUN_URL/" '{server: $s, timeout: 60, callback_base_url: $cb, tool_call: {name: "read_subject", arguments: {subject: "pub"}}}')" \ --check ok eq true --check authorization_url matches "^http://127.0.0.1:$OAUTH_PORT/authorize\\?" --field job_id) control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JP" --check status eq authorizing --check callback_ready eq true --until-ok 20 --save F19.oauth-redirect-route/authorizing PAU=$(control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JP" --field authorization_url) "$PY" -c "$QS_OF" "$PAU" | control-agent-server assert --check redirect_uri eq "$CBR" --check state exists PCB=$(curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$PAU") test "${PCB%%\?*}" = "$CBR" PQ=$("$PY" -c "$QS_OF" "$PCB") PCODE=$(echo "$PQ" | jq -r .code) PSTATE=$(echo "$PQ" | jq -r .state) control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query "code=$PCODE" --query "state=$PSTATE" --expect 200 \ --check . contains '

Authorization complete

' --check-header content-type contains text/html --save F19.oauth-redirect-route/redirect control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JP" --until-ok 30 --save F19.oauth-redirect-route/succeeded \ --check status eq succeeded --check tools contains read_subject --check tool_result.text eq QA_HTTP_SUBJECT:pub \ --check oauth_state.tokens.access_token matches '^gAAAA' --check oauth_state.client_info.client_id exists control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query "code=$PCODE" --query "state=$PSTATE" --expect 409 \ --check . contains 'This sign-in was already completed.' --save F19.oauth-redirect-route/replay control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JP" --check status eq succeeded
